Boutique 3.1 is focused on correctness and performance improvements. Most of these were found by @inanna-malick using her technique of [Property Testing with Agent Swarms](https://recursion.wtf/posts/agents-and-property-tests). The findings were primarily correctness bugs, but they also opened up opportunities for other improvements to the Store's correctness, mutation ordering, and Keychain persistence.

### Store correctness

- Fix chained removals using the wrong storage keys on disk. (#84)
- Preser

Say hello to [plugins](https://github.com/mergesort/Boutique#coding-agent-plugins) for Claude Code and Codex. Now your favorite coding agent can learn, use, and integrate Boutique into your app without you lifting a finger.

This release restores a behavior where updating a `StoredValue` or `SecurelyStoredValue` would update any View that was referencing those values.
